prompt: Walk me through FedRAMP POA&M remediation timelines and continuous monitoring expectations.
assertions: States the POA&M remediation SLAs by severity: High 30 days, Moderate 90 days, Low 180 days from identification
Covers ConMon cadence: monthly vulnerability scanning/deliverables, annual assessments, significant-change processes
Ties ConMon to the machine-readable era where relevant (existing Rev5 providers convert packages at the next annual assessment after September 30, 2026)
Mentions escalation/consequence framing (agency/PMO visibility, risk of suspension or revocation for chronic non-compliance)
Output is actionable: table or structured cadence rather than vague prose
